method: Ran atomscan and cleave facts on each original, inspected every byte and parsed YAML. No samples, CI jobs, tests, or fetched package code executed. Followed source entry points and their effects rather than relying on scanner scores.
source_label_explanation: Likely a benign configuration member inherited a hostile label from a containing repository/archive or from Discord-library reuse by malware. This is an inference: the upstream label record supplies no original repository or reason, and these standalone files do not establish the containing project is benign.

dependency_review.DiscordGo: New(token) initializes a Session without connecting. eventhandlers.go init only registers type providers. Session.Open calls Gateway and dials its returned Discord gateway; Request -> RequestWithBucketID -> RequestRaw -> RequestWithLockedBucket JSON-serializes caller data, adds the caller-provided token, and sends it through http.Client.Do. endpoints.go defaults to discord.com, status.discord.com and cdn.discordapp.com. No filesystem harvesting or process execution was found in library initialization. TestMain reads explicit DG*/DGB_TOKEN integration-test settings, creates sessions, and m.Run executes tests; network integration tests skip when credentials are absent. Example init functions parse arguments; example main functions are not run by go test. Fetched current source is supporting provenance, not a pinned historical resolution.
dependency_review.golint: golint/main parses args; ./... expands through allPackagesInFS. lintDir uses go/build.ImportDir; lintFiles reads selected Go source files and calls Linter.LintFiles. parser.ParseFile parses ASTs, typeCheck imports type information, f.lint applies style checks, then suggestions print and set_exit_status returns 1 when necessary. It does not execute the analyzed Go source.
dependency_review.gorilla/websocket v1.4.2: Fetched the version in DiscordGo go.mod. DefaultDialer is configuration only. Dial -> DialContext parses caller URL, negotiates HTTP Upgrade over TCP/TLS and returns a framed WebSocket connection. Its capability matches its documented networking purpose; no hardcoded attacker destination or automatic task execution.
dependency_review.golang.org/x/tools 2f3ba24bd6e7: Fetched the direct dependency from golint go.mod. Followed go/ast/astutil and go/gcexportdata into go/internal/gcimporter. gcexportdata.Find resolves compiler archive paths; NewReader isolates export data; Read dispatches indexed/binary export parsing into type objects. This reachable path parses compiler metadata, not arbitrary source execution. Other tools in the repository are not invoked by golint.

trait_review.ci_declarations: Existing metadata/build/ci/host and step findings correctly describe filenames and declared commands. New notable go get/go test observations refine the command declarations without claiming execution was observed or that installation is hostile.
